description: WANDa health check: a review-only, warning-only set per region folder, one row per model and DMA, keyed by names (model name + GIS set + DMA). v0 (basis start) files the build-time model-vs-GIS compare that PLDR builds already compute. Every app reads the newest set for its models; a missing set = 'no health check available'. Never feeds scores or plans, never refuses an app. Not a delivery schema: written only by wanda_import health.

fields.risk_rules: the risk_rules block below as used
fields.projects: [{model_name, project_id, project_version, folder_rel, gis_set, models_set, built_at, status, sources: {source: found true / false}}]

fields.gis: the gis set name the check used: wanda_client check reports STALE when a newer GIS set is filed

risk_rules.rule: risk = highest default_risk of the row's facts (none < low < medium < high); a not modelled DMA = not_assessed; no facts = none

types.ref: text exactly as recorded; never changed
types.code: a code from the field's code list

dma_health.description: One row per model and DMA, plus one model row (blank dma_ref) per model. File dma_health.csv, header = the field names in this order.

fields.name: model_name
fields.description: Model name (wanda_names rule <area>_<version>_Model), as the PLDR project records it

fields.name: gis_set
fields.description: The GIS set this health check is against: the newest finished inputs\gis set in the region folder when the check ran (blank region GIS: the project's build GIS set)

fields.name: dma_ref
fields.description: DMA reference as in the GIS; blank = the model row (one per model, project-wide counts)

fields.name: build_gis_set
fields.description: The GIS set the project was built on (pldr_project.json inputs_from.gis)

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: PLDR project id

fields.name: project_version
fields.description: PLDR project version number (the live version)

fields.name: models_set
fields.description: The models set the project was built from (pldr_project.json inputs_from.models)

fields.name: built_at
fields.description: When the project raw build completed (last project_raw_build complete in the build log)

fields.name: basis
fields.description: start = build-time model-vs-GIS compare (v0); change = GIS change log against the previous extract (v1)

fields.name: dma_state
fields.description: How far the model covers the DMA (model on the model row)

fields.name: gis_pipes
fields.description: GIS pipes in the DMA in the project's GIS (model row: every GIS pipe in the project)

fields.name: linked_pipes
fields.description: Of those, GIS pipes linked to a model pipe

fields.name: pipe_link_pct
fields.description: linked_pipes / gis_pipes x 100, one decimal (= the PLDR regional ranking model coverage)

fields.name: gis_length_m
fields.description: GIS pipe length in the DMA

fields.name: modelled_length_m
fields.description: Length of the DMA's GIS pipes linked to the model

fields.name: length_pct
fields.description: modelled_length_m / gis_length_m x 100, one decimal

fields.name: trace_status
fields.description: The PLDR trace readiness state as the build recorded it (pass, pass_multi_inlet, warning, blocked, no_customers); blank = not evaluated

fields.name: trace_coverage_pct
fields.description: Share of the DMA's customers the trace reaches

fields.name: model_pipes
fields.description: Model row only: model pipes in the project's model

fields.name: model_pipes_linked
fields.description: Model row only: model pipes linked to at least one GIS pipe

fields.name: spatial_rejected
fields.description: Spatial (geometry) links the build refused (model row: all of them)

fields.name: linked_mains_no_dma
fields.description: Model row only: GIS mains linked to the model with no DMA in the GIS

fields.name: risk_level
fields.description: The one generic risk: the highest default_risk of risk_reasons; not_assessed when the DMA is not modelled; none when there are no reasons

fields.name: risk_reasons
fields.description: The health_fact codes found for the row (';' separated); blank = none
